brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the effect of gemcabene on the pharmacokinetics of simvastatin 80 mg.
brief_title: Effect of Gemcabene on the Pharmacokinetics of Simvastatin in Healthy Volunteers

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males and Females
* \>18 years of age
* Body weight 45 kg or greater

Exclusion Criteria:

* If female, of childbearing potential or lactation
* History of significant adverse reaction to any fibrate lipid-lowering agent or HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor

official_title: A Study to Evaluate the Effects of Gemcabene on the Steady-State Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Simvastatin in Healthy Volunteers
